image-transfer.chunk.create-copy.note: Button in the image transfer dialog that saves a duplicate of the image as a new one.

image-transfer.chunk.delete-name-cards-t.text: Delete {name}? Cards that use it show that the image is missing. This cannot be undone.
image-transfer.chunk.delete-name-cards-t.note: Confirmation before deleting an image from the library. {name} is the image's name, chosen by the user.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.duplicate-name.note: Label of a library action that copies an image. {name} is the image's name, chosen by the user.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.duplicated-as-name.note: Confirmation after an image was copied. {name} is the name of the new copy.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.export-all-images.note: Label of the action that exports every saved image to one file. It tells the user the whole image library is included.

image-transfer.chunk.n.note: Part of an image's summary line. {n} is how many connections the image has. A connection links a part of the image to a Home Assistant entity.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

image-transfer.chunk.n-kb.note: File size of an image in the summary line. {n} is a whole number of kilobytes, at least 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.name-copy.note: Suggested name for a copied image. {name} is the name of the original image.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.name-for-the-copy-o.note: Label of the name field when copying an image. {name} is the name of the original image.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.chunk.new-image.note: Button in the image transfer dialog that starts a blank image in the image editor.

image-transfer.chunk.view-name.note: Label of a library action that opens an image. {name} is the image's name, chosen by the user.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-transfer.reader.connection-n-is-no.text: Connection {n} is not valid, so it was left out.
image-transfer.reader.connection-n-is-no.note: Import warning. {n} is the position (starting at 1) of the skipped connection in the imported file. A connection links a part of the image to an entity.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-transfer.reader.n.text: {n, plural, one {# more connection is not valid, so it was left out.} other {# more connections are not valid, so they were left out.}}
image-transfer.reader.n.note: Import warning. {n} is how many further connections were skipped because they have no name.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

image-transfer.reader.only-the-first-max.text: {max, plural, one {Only the first # connection was kept.} other {Only the first # connections were kept.}}
image-transfer.reader.only-the-first-max.note: Import warning. {max} is the largest number of connections one image may have.

vars.max: The most connections an image keeps.

image-transfer.reader.the-image-could-no.text: The image could not be read.
image-transfer.reader.the-image-could-no.note: Error in the import report for an image entry that has no readable drawing. It tells the user that image could not be imported.

image-transfer.reader.the-image-holds-ma.text: The image holds markup that is not allowed.
image-transfer.reader.the-image-holds-ma.note: Import error. The SVG file contains code, such as scripts, that is blocked for safety.

image-transfer.reader.the-image-is-large.text: The image is larger than {kb} KB.
image-transfer.reader.the-image-is-large.note: Import error. {kb} is the largest file size allowed, in kilobytes.

vars.kb: The value that replaces kb in the text.
